import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long a = sc.nextLong();
        long b = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long bx = 0, by = 0;
        long bbi = 1;
        long eps = 1000000000L;
        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long tx = (i * a) / b;
            for (int j = -5; j <= 5; j++) {
                long t = tx + j;
                long tbi = b * i;
                if (Math.abs(b * t - a * i) * bbi < eps * tbi) {
                    eps = Math.abs(b * t - a * i);
                    bx = t;
                    by = i;
                    bbi = tbi;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(bx + "/" + by);
        sc.close();
    }
}
